subject: [PATCH RFC v4 03/12] mm: rename get_user_page_vma_remote() to get_user_page_lookup_vma()

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch renames the function get_user_page_vma_remote() to get_user_page_lookup_vma() in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module. The renamed function still faults in a page at the specified address and looks up the VMA that covers it, but now with a more descriptive name that reflects its purpose of looking up the VMA. This change is intended to improve code readability and does not introduce any functional changes. The patch affects several files in the kernel, including arch-specific code and header files.
